wholePhysicalScope: Named cadastral corner and three mapped building parts, the exact November 2003 photo by Yang wl, and Taipei’s historic property designation.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the chamfer, reflected curtain wall, yellow fascia and setback rooftop. Near levels add the mullions, lettering and ground-floor glazing.
limitations: The exterior represents the former department store with its glass-clad Cathay United Bank frontage as photographed in 2003. The pre-renovation street façade is outside this reconstruction.

Rear cladding, seventh-floor rooftop enclosure, curtain-wall heights and secondary signage are estimated. Current mapped parts establish the geographic envelope. Lettering is simplified original geometry.

The original elevation field is preserved. The urban source heights are approximate and include several metres of relief across the footprint. Street-level glazing and wall contact follow the sampled field.
